paragraphs: DaySmart Recreation sells software for running sports and recreation facilities, covering registration, payment and space management. The recreation site now presents that software under the name Dash. The pitch is simpler scheduling, tighter operations and new revenue for a facility.

Scheduling runs on a drag and drop calendar used to build leagues, book facilities and confirm rentals in one place. It handles seasons, classes and events as well as leagues. Reporting is aimed at finding where revenue can grow. Customer messaging uses segmentation and tagging to target who hears what.

Listed solutions include parks and recreation management. Ice rink management is another. Higher-education recreation facilities are named as well. Other listed venues run to swim clubs, gymnastics and driving ranges. The company says it has worked alongside this industry for more than twenty years. The site is published by DaySmart Software.

quote.text: Simplify scheduling, streamline operations, and unlock new revenue opportunities
